decisions.statement: A character is named by the key the addon filed that character under.
The first account with characters answers and the rest go unread.
A lua list and a lua table of the same numbers read the same.
A motif book is placed by the lore table rather than by its own name.
A scribing script counts as known only where the saved variables say that script is unlocked.
A skill line the saved variables hold with no current rank reads as being at rank zero.
A skill line the saved variables never name is absent rather than at rank zero.
A curse state that is neither vampire nor werewolf reads as no curse at all.
A trait is named by the crafting type it is researched under and by its own name.
A trait's name is lowered, because the name an item carries is cased its own way.
A trait unresearched on any one line is unresearched for the crafting type.
Nothing here talks to the game.

definition: what each character knows, read out of the characters saved variables
